errors.evidence: The description incorrectly merges two distinct categories from the x-axis, "Етерично-маслени и..." (Essential oil and...) and "Фуражни култури" (Forage crops), into a single category "Етерично-маслени и фуражни култури". The chart shows five separate crop categories, but the description only lists four, combining the last two.

errors.evidence: The vertical axis itself has no label. The label "Площ, ХА" (Area, Hectares) is present in the legend entries, not on the axis.
The phrase "and are marked with a number" is awkward and unclear. The legend entries are the years themselves (e.g., 2007, 2010), which are numbers, but the phrasing is clumsy.
